description: S52 T4 (LM1): the memory doors are agent-scoped in BOTH directions. A person session reaching learnings.mine.query is refused by name with the pointer sentence — the person's own reads are learnings.query, learnings.show, the board and the history, which answer over everything legitimately theirs. This is the opposite of the slice's human-door pattern on purpose: here the scoped surface is the agent's, and neither caller can borrow the other's view.

params.queryText: whatever a person typed at the agent's door

error.message: invalid params: refused: this door is agent-scoped; a person uses learnings.query (learnings.board to browse, learnings.forAgent to ask what an agent would be shown)
